name: Dark Feature List
description: Dark two-column section recreated from a Figma frame: a large left heading over a faint grid and a brand corner glow, beside a right column of four feature items, each a brand dot + title + description divided by hairline brand rules. Items reveal on scroll and lift on hover.
interactions: entrance reveal: heading + items fade/translate up once on scroll into view (IntersectionObserver threshold .2), staggered 60/140/220/300ms, .7s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) (motion added; the Figma frame is static)
item hover: divider brightens transparent-brand -> full brand, item nudges translateX(4px), dot scales 1.18, all .25s
prefers-reduced-motion: reveal + hover transitions off, everything rendered in its final state
responsive: two columns on desktop, single stacked column below 768px
